explain.vi: “Buổi sáng khôn hơn buổi tối” là câu tục ngữ Nga.
explain.en: "The morning is wiser than the evening" is a Russian proverb.
explain.zh-Hans: “早晨比夜晚聪明”是俄罗斯谚语。
explain.tl: Kasabihang Ruso ang 'mas matalino ang umaga kaysa gabi'.
explain.id: "Pagi lebih bijak daripada malam" adalah pepatah Rusia.
explain.pt: "A manhã é mais sábia que a noite" é um provérbio russo.
explain.my: 'မနက်က ညထက် ပညာရှိ' က ရုရှားစကားပုံ။

explain.vi: Cô chị cố ý tắt nến, bắt Vasilisa đi xin lửa.
explain.en: A sister put out the candle and sent her for fire.
explain.zh-Hans: 姐姐故意弄灭蜡烛，叫她去要火。
explain.ko: 언니가 일부러 불을 끄고 불을 얻어 오라고 했다.
explain.tl: Pinatay ng kapatid ang kandila at pinahingi siya ng apoy.
explain.ne: दिदीले मैनबत्ती निभाएर आगो माग्न पठाइन्।
explain.id: Kakak memadamkan lilin dan menyuruhnya minta api.
explain.pt: Uma irmã apagou a vela e a mandou buscar fogo.
explain.my: အစ်မက ဖယောင်းတိုင်ငြိမ်းပြီး မီးတောင်းခိုင်းတယ်။
explain.th: พี่สาวดับเทียนแล้วให้ไปขอไฟ

quiz.ja: 赤い服の男が通ったあと、何が起きましたか。

explain.vi: Người áo đỏ là mặt trời: anh ta qua thì mặt trời mọc.
explain.en: The red rider is the sun: when he passed, the sun rose.
explain.zh-Hans: 红衣人是太阳，他一过太阳就升起。
explain.ko: 빨간 옷의 남자가 지나가자 해가 떴다.
explain.tl: Pagdaan ng nakapula, sumikat ang araw.
explain.ne: रातो लुगाको मान्छे गएपछि घाम उदायो।
explain.id: Setelah penunggang merah lewat, matahari terbit.
explain.pt: Quando o cavaleiro vermelho passou, o sol nasceu.
explain.my: အနီဝတ်လူ ဖြတ်သွားတော့ နေထွက်တယ်။
explain.th: พอชายชุดแดงผ่านไป ดวงอาทิตย์ก็ขึ้น
